scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev-fe: concurrently -n frontend -c green "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w electron"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:electron: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && cd electron && npm run build
scripts.dist:server: npm run build && cd electron && npm run build:server
scripts.dist:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && cd electron && npm run build:client
